research.title: Data Preparation and Baselines for Support Request Classification
bullets: Cleaned support request text, checked category annotations against supplied guidelines, and removed duplicate records before constructing training and evaluation splits.
Implemented term frequency–inverse document frequency features and logistic regression baselines, summarizing classification errors across overlapping request categories for group review.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded inventory discrepancies, and routed missing or damaged item reports to the appropriate staff.
Maintained order paperwork, organized stockroom supplies, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements while updating daily handover notes for the next shift.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented multinomial naive Bayes and logistic regression classifiers using bag-of-words features to predict sentiment labels from short product reviews.
Compared unigram and bigram representations on a held-out split, inspecting misclassified examples involving negation, mixed sentiment, and ambiguous wording.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented a centroid-based extractive summarization baseline that ranked document sentences by cosine similarity between sentence vectors and the document representation.
Compared selected sentences with a leading-sentence baseline, examining redundancy and coverage of central topics through manual review of generated summaries.
